title: Why Does That Taco Cost So Much?

titles.option_a_curiosity: Why Does That Taco Cost So Much?
titles.option_b_contrarian: The Hidden Price Tag On Every Choice
titles.option_c_search_hybrid: Opportunity Cost: The Price You Can't See

description:
Ever pick the taco, then regret the concert you gave up? This behavioral economics explainer turns a five-dollar choice into a vivid lesson about opportunity cost and the true price of every decision.

The story follows a stick figure at a food truck who picks tacos over a half-price concert ticket, then starts to feel what that choice quietly took away. It explains that opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative you give up, not merely the cash you hand over. That means the real price of the tacos includes the concert you didn't attend. Pixel scenes carry the idea across a night street, a concert crowd, a cost ledger and a forking road, before returning to the same food truck. It's a simple way to make the tradeoffs hiding inside ordinary yes-or-no moments visible.

What's the last choice you made where the hidden cost surprised you?
